label: WhatsApp Fetch Media (Baileys)
description: Download one WhatsApp message's media (voice note, picture, document) into storage by `messageId`, for entries from BaileyFetchMessages, which carry the id but not the bytes (BaileyReceive already stores live media). The bridge must still hold the message.

inputs.name: bridge
inputs.description: The `bridge` output of the BaileyBridge node to talk through.
